notesThisBatch: The shipment transaction view imports transaction types and consumes ledger rows. This batch migrates that dependency and the transaction report consumer before building the main shipment workflow

Root ITransaction contains only ledger fields, canonical account/staff references and nested invoice metadata. Filters and request/response wrappers stay in Api.ts; no shipment or merchant stub model was introduced
JavaScript feature slices retain list state only. Each list wrapper remains simple while its table owns query initialization/pagination and its header owns filter controls

Wallet and COD queries/controls honor their own view grants; all-balance reads require both scopes. New writes require create and existing edits require update; create-only staff cannot edit existing records

The legacy detail save button reused create permission for edits. The migration applies the explicit update grant to PATCH operations while keeping separate wallet/COD grants and the merchant-update requirement on the original all/new entry route

Custom operation is a valid original default/submittable value even though the old select omitted its label. It is now displayed explicitly without enabling inactive reset or accounting generation controls

Inclusive deposit tax is removed from gross amounts before balance credit; the separate historical amount-with-tax column retains its original cutoff and invoice/taxable conditions. Stored records do not inherit a new tax flag when one was absent
Operation label prefixes are added only to the outgoing notes. Failed saves preserve raw notes, and already prefixed notes do not receive a duplicate prefix when an existing record is saved
Successful creation returns to the migrated account ledger before optional balance refresh can fail; retries cannot duplicate the successful monetary write
Server PDF/XLSX exports previously used the visible list page with a 50000-row page size and could skip records. Exports now start at zero and preserve all active filters
Missing report URLs and HTTP download errors now reject visibly and release loading. Temporary links/object URLs are cleaned; merchant exports retain backend current-account ownership
Staff wallet/COD audit links are enabled. The earlier foundations regression was updated to recognize these newly migrated owning features; no default grants or excluded features were added
Merchant profile navigation and top-up entry points remain deferred to their pending owning features rather than opening unavailable routes
